scope: Russia medical discovery — Pirogov University General Medicine

verifiedFacts.claim: Pirogov University identifies General Medicine (31.05.01) as a six-year full-time specialist programme available in Russian and English, with a dedicated curriculum for English-speaking foreign citizens.
The international admissions route states that General Medicine is available in Russian or English and requires a signed tuition contract and one-semester payment for fee-paying enrollment.
The 2026 fee-paying specialist timeline opens applications 20 June 2026 and lists document, entrance-examination, agreement and enrolment dates through 27 August 2026.
